tr: Fa ḥamdan li Mawlānā wa shukran li Rabbinā
en: You are Blessed O Allah, My Lord, Glory is Yours –And praise our Patron's and thanks is our Lord's.

ar: أَقَمْتَ بِهَا الْأَكْوَانَ مِنْ حَضْرَةِ الْغِنَا
en: By Your Beautiful Names and their secrets by which –You established existence from Being Sufficiently-Rich.

tr: Fa nad`ūka Yā Allāhu Yā Mubdi`a ‘l-warā
en: So we call on You, O Allah, O Maker of Mortals –With certainty, protecting us from worry, anguish and trials.

tr: Wa Yā Rabbu Yā Raḥmānu habnā ma`ārifan
Wa luṭfan wa iḥsānan wa nūran ya`ummunā.
en: O Lord, O Merciful, bestow realisation on us – Subtleties, excellence and light encompassing us

tr: Wa sir Yā Raḥīma ‘l-`Ālamīna bi jam`inā
en: O Merciful of the Worlds, collectively march us – To the Presence of sanctified nearness, guide us
